meta.name: CareerForge ₹1 Cr Career Intelligence Benchmark
meta.note: Proprietary competency + compensation model used to score candidates against the ₹1 Cr+ CTC bar in the Indian market. This is the data layer that makes CareerForge a diagnostic engine, not a chatbot.

readiness_bands.label: Offer-Ready
readiness_bands.verdict: You clear the ₹1 Cr bar today. Focus is now on positioning and negotiation, not gaps.

readiness_bands.label: Contender
readiness_bands.verdict: You are a credible ₹1 Cr candidate with 2–3 sharp gaps to close before you'll convert at the top tier.

readiness_bands.label: Emerging
readiness_bands.verdict: Strong foundation, but the story doesn't yet read at the ₹1 Cr level. A focused 60–90 day sprint changes that.

readiness_bands.label: Foundation
readiness_bands.verdict: The raw material is there. We build the ₹1 Cr narrative deliberately, dimension by dimension.

competency_dimensions.label: Impact & Scale
competency_dimensions.definition: Evidence of business outcomes at scale — revenue, cost, users, latency, uptime — with hard numbers.
competency_dimensions.cr_signal: Owned outcomes measured in ₹ crores, millions of users/transactions, or company-level metrics.

competency_dimensions.label: Leadership & Influence
competency_dimensions.definition: Leading people, cross-functional programs, and decisions that others execute.
competency_dimensions.cr_signal: Led teams/orgs, set strategy, hired, and influenced beyond your direct line.

competency_dimensions.label: Domain & Technical Depth
competency_dimensions.definition: Mastery of the craft and domain the target role demands.
competency_dimensions.cr_signal: Recognised expert — sought out for the hardest problems in this domain.

competency_dimensions.label: Strategic & Commercial
competency_dimensions.definition: Connecting work to P&L, market, and company strategy — thinking like an owner.
competency_dimensions.cr_signal: Framed work in commercial terms; made build/buy/bet calls with money on the line.

competency_dimensions.label: Brand & Visibility
competency_dimensions.definition: External proof: LinkedIn presence, talks, writing, referrals, reputation.
competency_dimensions.cr_signal: A market that knows you — inbound interest, strong network, public proof.

competency_dimensions.label: Executive Communication
competency_dimensions.definition: Crisp, senior, outcome-first communication that lands with leaders.
competency_dimensions.cr_signal: Communicates like an operator — clarity, brevity, and narrative that moves decisions.

salary_bands_inr.note: Approximate total CTC bands (fixed + variable + ESOP value) for the Indian market, senior tiers. Used to place a candidate and set negotiation anchors.
